'''Jheramahd Greyshade's apartment''' was an apartment in the [[500 Republica/Legends|''500 Republica'']] apartment building. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], Senator [[Jheramahd Greyshade|Greyshade]] was assassinated and afterwards thrown from the roof of the building.
